title: Referral Intake Standard for Home Oxygen Therapy: Lead from Written Order to Initial-Setup Delivery
content:
# Lead from Written Order to Initial-Setup Delivery — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Standard.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy setup, the patient's first day at home replaces the initial-setup delivery date only when the initial-setup delivery came no more than **1 day** after the written order was received for an order from a hospital discharge, no more than **2 days** after it for an order from a skilled nursing facility, and **0 days** after it for any other order. The lead is counted in calendar days as the later date minus the earlier date, from the order date on the oxygen record to the initial-setup delivery. When the condition fails, the setup day stays the initial-setup delivery date.

| Referral source of the order | Longest lead from the written order to the initial-setup delivery |
|---|---|
| hospital discharge | 1 day |
| skilled nursing facility | 2 days |
| any other source | 0 days |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Referral source | Written order received | Initial-setup delivery | Lead | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| hospital discharge | 14 July | 15 July | 1 day | met |
| hospital discharge | 14 July | 16 July | 2 days | fails |
| skilled nursing facility | 14 July | 16 July | 2 days | met |
| skilled nursing facility | 14 July | 17 July | 3 days | fails |
| any other source | 14 July | 14 July | 0 days | met |
| any other source | 14 July | 15 July | 1 day | fails |

**Reading note.** The lead runs from the day the written order was received to the day of the initial-setup delivery.
